_: THE HARNESS AIMED AT ITSELF — run it from this crate's directory:
Every property this tool holds is a property its own suite claims to hold,
and a claim nobody has broken is a claim nobody has measured. So each
injection here removes ONE of them and names the tests that must go red.
A green run of this file says the suite is not vacuous; a `did not reach`
says a test passes for a reason other than the one it is written for.
Keep it runnable: the `from` texts are exact, and a source edit that moves
one of them makes this sweep refuse out loud rather than pass quietly.
AND EVERY INJECTION INTO `src/` REDDENS ONE TEST NOBODY AIMED AT IT:
every sweep this repository tracks, and while an injection is in the tree the
anchors of THIS file no longer match the source they name. That is the law
working, not a guard nobody wrote down — so it is left as a reported
`unexpected` rather than named as an expectation, which would claim the read
under injection is what reddened it. It is also why this manifest does not
declare its red sets exhaustive: under that claim the artefact would fail the
sweep it is an artefact of.

injections.name: a-record-is-read-as-absent-when-it-will-not-parse
injections.why: R1198 — a firing record that has been corrupted and a sweep nobody has ever run must not be the same answer. Reading a broken record as `no record` demotes a PROVEN sweep into the counted-and-excused bucket, which is the direction that reads as compliance

edits.from:
serde_json::from_str(&raw)
        .map(Some)
        .map_err(|e| format!("{} is not a firing record: {e}", path.display()))

injections.name: an-edited-injection-keeps-the-evidence-of-the-old-one
injections.why: R1198 — the row is kept beside the definition it was proven against precisely so that editing the injection invalidates it. A comparison that looks only at the name carries yesterday's proof forward under today's edits, which is the whole failure the record exists to prevent

injections.name: a-record-belongs-to-a-directory-rather-than-a-sweep
injections.why: R1198's own first draft, which `tools/ci-plan/` refuted the day it was written: that directory holds TWO manifests, so one record per directory made the second sweep's every injection read as unproven and the first sweep's evidence read as answering to nothing

injections.name: the-supervisor-stops-dying-with-the-harness
injections.why: PR_SET_PDEATHSIG is the only notification a SIGKILLed parent can arrange in advance; without it nothing under a killed sweep is told to stop

injections.name: nothing-leads-its-own-process-group
injections.why: one kill must reach every test binary the suite spawned, not only the cargo that spawned them; without a group of its own there is nothing to signal

injections.name: the-supervisor-stops-putting-the-tree-back
injections.why: the originals are on disk precisely so a process the harness cannot reach can restore them; with the restore gone a killed sweep leaves its injection in the tree

injections.name: the-exit-code-goes-back-to-being-recorded-only
injections.why: the status a suite exited with and the names its log listed are each blind where the other sees; recorded side by side and never compared, the pair is worth the weaker of the two

injections.name: the-sweep-supervises-from-a-path-instead-of-its-own-copy
injections.why: the first self-check ever run died here: the suite rebuilt this binary, /proc/self/exe named a deleted file, and the second injection could not be started at all

injections.name: the-manifest-paths-are-resolved-against-whoever-ran-it
injections.why: the suite runs with the TREE as its working directory, so a relative log path resolves somewhere else the moment it is handed across — the first real sweep under a supervisor died of exactly this. R1108 moved the base from the caller's directory to the MANIFEST'S, because a reader of every tracked sweep cannot know where each was meant to be run from and that answer lived in prose; taking the caller's directory back reads `../..` from wherever somebody happened to stand

injections.name: a-tree-somebody-else-injected-is-taken-as-a-baseline
injections.why: a sweep that starts on a tree still holding a dead sweep's injection measures that injection as the state everything is compared against

injections.name: a-sweep-whose-anchor-came-loose-goes-unnoticed
injections.why: R1108 — THE DEFECT THIS LAW IS ABOUT, injected into a real tracked sweep. An anchor is exact text and the source it names moves; R1103 put one line between the two lines the census gate's sweep matched on, and from that commit that sweep applied to nothing and NEITHER DID THE TWENTY-FIVE INJECTIONS BESIDE IT, because the pre-flight refuses whole. Four rounds passed before anybody ran it. A file that has stopped proving reads exactly like one that holds

injections.name: an-anchor-that-matches-twice-is-close-enough
injections.why: matching nothing and matching twice are the two ways an anchor stops describing one change — the second is the quieter, because the edit still lands, on whichever copy came first, and the sweep reports a red nobody described. `tools/uncompiled-sources` grew a second call site with the same three lines and its sweep had been refusing on that ever since

injections.name: a-report-carries-counts-under-no-suite-at-all
injections.why: R1138 read a red set of exactly one off this report and wrote it down as what nothing else in the repository guards — while the run had been scoped `-p mnemosyne-cli` and the edits landed in `mnemosyne-validate`, whose own suite therefore never ran and could not have appeared in any red set. The number was right about the run and wrong about the repository, and the report said nothing either way. A measurement whose condition is invisible is read as unconditional

injections.name: the-control-only-mode-prints-a-shape-of-its-own
injections.why: the other half of the same law, and it needs its own injection because the field assertion above cannot reach it: a control printed as a bare run object carries counts under no population AND under no shape a reader can recognise, so knowing what the file in front of them measured requires knowing which flag produced it

injections.name: a-red-nobody-described-is-counted-and-never-judged
injections.why: R1139 widened one sweep's scope from a crate to the workspace and 29 reds became 41 — the twelve new ones invisible for as long as nothing asked. `missed` catches a manifest run NARROWER than it was measured; this is the other direction, and without it a manifest that declares its red sets whole makes a claim nothing enforces

injections.name: an-exhaustive-set-of-nothing-is-a-claim-worth-suites
injections.why: under the weaker claim an empty `expect_red` is honest — an exploratory sweep says what went red and judges nothing — but under the stronger one it asserts that breaking the read changes NOTHING, the single outcome a sweep exists to detect. Refused at read time for the same reason the dry-run pre-flight exists: the whole-workspace sweep this claim was built for is 85 minutes of suites

injections.name: a-key-nobody-reads-is-taken-as-a-key-nobody-wrote
injections.why: every optional field is one a manifest may simply not carry, so a MISSPELLED key reads as absent and the sweep runs under the default while its author reads their own spelling — `red-set: exhaustive` would leave the weaker claim in force with the file saying the stronger one. R1136 paid for this exact shape in another gate, where a derived serde default rebuilt the collapse the type had replaced

injections.name: the-population-of-sweeps-is-whatever-a-glob-finds
injections.why: a law over zero files passes, and it passes in the shape of a clean run. The harness's own sweep is not called `injection-sweep.json`, so the obvious glob leaves out the one aimed at the tool every other sweep is run by — and R1134 measured the second half of the same mistake: a glob on `tools/` left out the sweep R1132 put in `.githooks/`, which is aimed at SHELL and is the likeliest anchor in this repository to come loose. R1199 MOVED THE WALK INTO THE LIBRARY, because a second crate now asks the same question, and this anchor came loose in that commit — the sweep refused whole until it was pointed at the new home, which is this injection's own subject happening to itself

injections.name: the-targets-a-run-reached-go-back-to-being-a-set
injections.why: cargo announces a test target by a path relative to ITS OWN package and names no package, so two crates that fold their suites into `tests/all.rs` are announced identically — this repository has exactly that pair. Counted into a set the two collapse into one element, and the harness then refuses the manifest for a collision no reading of the log could have resolved; counted into a multiset the pair is two targets both runs can be compared under, and a run that loses one of them says so by name and by count

injections.name: a-target-no-name-covers-is-close-enough
injections.why: the by-name comparison replaced a count, and it is only as strong as that count while every target is announced. A `test result:` with no `Running` line before it is a target the comparison cannot see at all — the run then differs from the control in a way the gap between them is structurally blind to, which is the shape where a smaller number reads as a cleaner one

injections.name: only-the-control-is-asked-whether-its-names-cover-it
injections.why: the same law needs a reader on BOTH sides, and the injected side is the one nothing else would catch: the names such a run did announce match the control's exactly, so the drift check is silent, and the injection reddens the test it was aimed at, so the aim check is too. A run that lost a whole target passes every other gate this tool has

injections.name: a-red-set-that-moved-since-the-proof-goes-back-to-being-silence
injections.why: R1201 — R1179 left the unnamed reds judged by nothing under the default claim, so a repaired injection's red set can GROW without anything saying: R1178's `a-dependency-bump-…` reddened three tests beyond its own, all legitimate, and a fourth that was not would have looked identical. The record R1198 built keeps the WHOLE set the last run measured, which is the one baseline the weak claim can be judged against. Stop comparing and the silence comes back

injections.name: the-evidence-a-run-is-replacing-outlives-the-control-it-reddens
injections.why: R1200 — the deadlock this sweep IS. Its control runs the harness's own suite, which holds R1198's law over firing records, so a row proven against an edited injection reddens the control and the harness refuses to start on a red control: the `--only` run that would clear the row can never happen. R1199 met it and escaped only because that row was still uncommitted, so `git checkout` could remove it; a committed one leaves discarding the whole record and re-proving every injection in it, which is the cost `--only` exists to avoid. Stop voiding the evidence this run is on its way to replacing and the trap comes back

injections.name: a-name-no-walk-can-see-goes-back-to-being-a-name-that-is-gone
injections.why: R1184's law rendered `this tree no longer has that test` about names generated by `macro_rules!`, which syn never walks into, and a round read that verdict and DELETED two true expectations from an exhaustive red set — quietly weakening it to prove less. The tokens an invocation is handed are the weaker question that can be answered. Stop reading them and the verdict goes back to being one this walk is not entitled to render, on the very names that paid for it
